title: Thinkspace Action Master — complete demo walkthrough
scope: Full Action Master workflow: access, filters, calendar, bucketlist, create, read, update, status, attachments, lifecycle (sections A–G, I). Agenda (H) is a separate demo.
prerequisites: Optional: E2E_DEMO_PAUSE_MS (default 1200) for headed video pacing

crudSummary.Read: Today/Week list, deep link /thinkspace/task/:id, detail tabs
crudSummary.Update: Description, progress slider, Do more/Derailed status, post update, attachments
crudSummary.Delete: Detail Delete (before Done — Done disables Delete on same record)

steps.title: Open Actions workspace
steps.userAction: Navigate to /thinkspace/task (Today view)
steps.uiLocation: TaskPage — work mode, view menu, bucketlist

steps.title: Agenda/Action work mode
steps.userAction: Ensure Agenda/Action work mode is active

steps.title: Action type filter bar
steps.userAction: Show filter bar → select Specific filter

steps.title: Switch to Week view
steps.userAction: View menu → Week

steps.title: Navigate previous and next week
steps.userAction: Previous week → Next week

steps.title: Return to Today view
steps.userAction: View menu → Actions · Today

steps.title: Open bucketlist panel
steps.userAction: Click Open bucketlist FAB if panel closed

steps.title: Capture idea in bucketlist
steps.userAction: Type title → Enter

steps.title: Preview Routine quick-create from bucket
steps.userAction: Bucket row → Routine → verify modal → Cancel

steps.title: Create Specific action from bucket
steps.userAction: Bucket row → Specific → fill form → + Create Action

steps.title: Deep link to action detail
steps.userAction: Navigate to /thinkspace/task/:id

steps.title: Browse detail modal tabs
steps.userAction: Progress → Updates → Attachments → Hierarchy

steps.title: Update description and progress
steps.userAction: Edit description → Save; Progress tab → 30% → Save

steps.title: Status — Do more (with note)
steps.userAction: Click Do more → enter required note in prompt

steps.title: Status — Derailed (with note)
steps.userAction: Click Derailed → enter required note in prompt

steps.title: Post progress update comment
steps.userAction: Type update → Post → verify on Updates tab

steps.title: Upload attachment on action
steps.userAction: Attachments tab → choose file → Upload

steps.title: Mark separate action as Done
steps.userAction: Open second action → Done (modal closes; progress API succeeds)
steps.note: Uses a second action so primary action can still be deleted in step 19

steps.title: Delete primary demo action
steps.userAction: Click Delete on main action (not Done)

steps.title: Remove leftover bucket item (if any)
steps.userAction: Click ✕ on bucket row
steps.note: Optional cleanup when bucket item was not consumed by create

excludedFromActionDemo.sectionH: Create agenda — use tests/thinkspace/workflow/08-create-agenda.ui.spec.ts or npm run demo:thinkspace-agenda when available
excludedFromActionDemo.actionPool: ERP admin Action pool / Timesheet views — admin-only
excludedFromActionDemo.listFilters: Search/Status/Priority/Source panel — toggled via showActionFilters (not default visible)
